acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of GEO targeting services for financial advisors varies significantly based on the scope of work, the competitiveness of the target markets, and the specific strategies employed. Factors like the number of target locations, desired ad spend for PPC campaigns, and the extent of local SEO optimization all influence pricing. Most digital marketing agencies offer customized packages, often starting from a few hundred to several thousand dollars per month, depending on the breadth and depth of the services.
